source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Steering, p.9-30

procedures.title: Relay rod (Corvette): remove and install
steps: Removal: remove the steering damper from the relay rod (see Steering Damper), then unbolt the anchor bracket from the relay rod (2 bolts).
Disconnect the inner tie rod ends from the relay rod as under tie rod removal.
Pull the cotter pin at the pitman arm ball stud end of the relay rod and remove the stud nut.
Tap the ball stud out of the pitman arm and lower the relay rod.
Remove the cotter key and nut at the idler arm, take the relay rod off the idler arm, and remove the washer and seal from the idler arm.

Installation: set the relay rod on the idler arm stud with the seal and washer in place, fit and tighten the nut, advancing it only enough to line up a castellation with the cotter pin hole, and fit the pin.
Fit a new seal and clamp over the ball at the pitman arm end.
Fit the inner spring seat and spring into the relay rod.
Lift the rod end onto the pitman arm.
notes: See figure 57 in the manual for the Corvette linkage layout.
